Subject: Next steps: Dedicated perf validation + GPU matrix for Medlytix

Alex / Priya — thanks again for the demo this morning. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we can size a short validation pilot that proves your latency & streaming SLOs before committing reserved capacity.

Key customer SLOs we heard (please confirm):
- 95th percentile tail latency <= 180ms for single-turn text generation (prompt + 256 tokens)
- Sustained throughput target: 180 requests/sec average during business hours, peak bursts up to ~450 req/sec for short windows
- Concurrency budget: ~12–20 simultaneous streaming sessions (chunked output) per inference shard
- Streaming: clients expect token-by-token streaming with jitter < 40ms between server token availability and client receive

Immediate asks for sizing and pilot: 
1) Confirm representative prompt distribution and token histogram (attachments: sample_prompts.csv recommended).
2) Confirm any hard constraints on model fidelity (do we need FP16 vs INT8 quantization?)
3) Preferred pilot length: we recommend a 48–72 hour pilot capturing mixed production-like traffic; confirm date windows.
4) We will share a short GPU comparison matrix and two pilot configs (cost vs latency tradeoffs) — Ben will attach.

Proposed pilot goals / success criteria:
- Meet 95p latency <= 180ms at your observed prompt mix for 95% of the pilot windows
- Validate sustained throughput of 180 req/sec with no retries and stable KV cache hit behavior
- Measure per-token cost and peak tail behavior under bursts; provide ops guidance for reserved throughput sizing

Next steps: Ben to send GPU matrix + pilot plan today; Alex / Priya to confirm prompt set + preferred pilot window; procurement to confirm PO path if pilot requires dedicated reserved instances.

Thanks — I will schedule a short sync after Ben's note to lock the pilot start.

—
Marissa Cole
Senior Solutions (Sales) Engineer, Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com

Thanks Marissa — that lines up with what we want to validate. Quick answers:
- Prompt distribution: ~60% short (<= 64 tokens), 30% mid (65–256), 10% long (257–1024). I'll upload a small sample file to the drive link in your doc.
- Fidelity: we prefer to start with FP16 for quality; open to INT8 if latency difference is material and you can show minimal quality drift on our eval set.
- Pilot window: Sept 28–30 (UTC) would work for staging; want a follow-up production pilot if stage looks good.

One ask from procurement: please include a notional estimate for reserved throughput (monthly committed capacity) and an itemized pilot cost for both GPU configs. That helps speed approval.

On the latency target: 95p <= 180ms is aggressive for some model variants when streaming; can you highlight the bits in the pilot that directly measure streaming jitter and token-level latency?

Alex — appreciate the quick clarifications. Attaching the comparison matrix and pilot checklist (see attachments). High-level summary below so procurement has a simple decision table: 

GPU choices we recommend comparing in the pilot:
- Option A: NVIDIA H100 (80GB) FP16 / TF32 path — best raw throughput for large context and streaming; typically lowest tail latency under high concurrency but higher hourly cost.
- Option B: NVIDIA A100 (80GB) with INT8/4-bit quantized model — lower cost per token, sometimes slightly higher tail latency on streaming for models that rely heavily on attention compute.

Notional pilot configs (we'll provision isolated reserved pool for each):
- Pilot-A (H100): 2x H100 hosts, expected baseline sustained throughput ~220 req/sec for your token mix, 95p latency estimate = 120–160ms (streaming enabled), concurrency headroom 20 sessions per shard. Estimated pilot cost: $5,200 (48 hrs) including orchestration and logging.
- Pilot-B (A100+INT8): 3x A100 hosts, baseline sustained throughput ~190 req/sec, 95p latency estimate = 150–200ms (some jitter at peak bursts), concurrency headroom 12–16 sessions per shard. Estimated pilot cost: $3,400 (48 hrs).

What we'll measure during pilot (summary):
- 95/99/99.9p latencies (prompt + 256 token completion)
- Streaming token latency (server availability -> client receive), measured per-chunk and as jitter distribution
- Throughput stability under a 1-hour 3x burst test (to simulate your peak)
- KV cache effectiveness and cold-start penalties
- Cost per 1k tokens and per-request tail cost estimate for reserved capacity sizing

Pilot acceptance criteria (pass/fail):
- Pilot meets 95p <= 180ms for >= 90% of sampled windows OR we surface a clear mitigation (cache tuning, batching tweak, model quantization) with tradeoffs documented.
- No single point of failure observed; we capture fallback behavior and routing policies.

Procurement note: the itemized pilot cost above is a notional line-item for approval. If you want a strictly capped PO, we can provide a DocuSign SOW after you confirm the pilot configuration.

Proposed immediate next steps:
- Alex: confirm Pilot-A vs Pilot-B preference (or run both in parallel; we recommend both if procurement allows).
- Priya / Procurement: if you want a single-run preference, indicate "Pilot-A only" or "A+B" and we’ll issue a pilot SOW.
- Karthik: I'll coordinate test harness and provide the exact traffic replay script + tokenization metrics.

If you'd like, we can do a 30-min tech check on Sept 27 to validate the sample prompt set and instrumentation.

—
Ben Carter
Staff Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
